sections.heading: A local crew that inspects before it sprays.
sections.body:
For fifteen years we have kept pests out of homes across the valley, and in that time we have run more than 60,000 service visits. One promise, kept every time: we find where the problem starts, treat it there, and show you the proof.

Every technician is our own employee, licensed by the state and trained in-house. No subcontractors, no mystery sprays, no "we'll see how it goes." If pests come back between visits, the same technician comes back and sorts it, free.

bullets.text: Family-owned and operated in the valley since 2011
Rated 4.9 out of 5 across 3,184 verified reviews
A written field report with photos on every visit

sections.heading: Know your enemy.
sections.intro: Five families of pest, one method: inspect, treat at the source, document.

cards.title: General pests
cards.body: Ants, roaches, spiders and crickets. Baited at the source, sealed out at the door.

cards.title: Scorpions
cards.body: UV night hunts, exclusion sealing and a perimeter they will not cross.

cards.title: Termites
cards.body: Licensed inspections, liquid barriers and bait systems with a renewable warranty.

cards.title: Rodents
cards.body: Roof rats and mice trapped out and sealed out with steel. Guaranteed.

cards.title: Biters & stingers
cards.body: Mosquitoes, wasps, fleas, ticks and bed bugs. Fast removal, safe yard.

sections.heading: One treatment is a visit. Four is a barrier.
sections.body: Pests do not book appointments, and a single spray wears off. A protection plan keeps a fresh barrier around your home all year, with scheduled visits timed to the valley's seasons and free re-treats whenever something gets through.

bullets.desc: Quarterly or monthly visits, timed to scorpion, monsoon and rodent seasons.
If pests come back before your next service, so do we, at no charge.
Someone who knows your home, your pets and where the problems start.

sections.heading: Big jobs, small monthly payments.
sections.body: A termite treatment or whole-home rodent exclusion does not have to be a single bill. Approved customers can spread the cost with low monthly payments and 0% APR for the first twelve months.
